description:
HushTelegram v0.0.24 targets telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.0 (org.telegram.messenger.web) and the Google Play build 13.2.1 (org.telegram.messenger) with 69 patches. It takes sponsored messages, search ads, Stories, recommendations and the Premium, gifts and Stars upsells out of Telegram, and keeps its usage reports on your phone. This release moves to Morphe patcher 2.3.0, and the 13.1 builds aren't supported anymore. Most of what's new came from your reports again. Special contacts keeps a history of the people you choose to track, and the phone number screen can sign you in on Telegram's test servers or with a bot token. Another new switch lets screenshots work in chats that don't allow saving. New switches start off, except Keep the Keep-Alive Service running, which only does anything while Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service is on.

If Telegram turns down your login code with API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD, that's it refusing the public API ID every patched build carries, the Play one included. Register an app at my.telegram.org/apps and fill in Use registered Telegram API credentials before patching. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, then Notifications, and turn on Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection.

Validation: 2048 runtime tests passed locally. All 625 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 69 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.0 (version code 72809) and the Google Play build 13.2.1 (version code 72911), and the release receipt checked each patched app's manifest, resource table, native libraries and alignment. Both builds were walked signed in on a Galaxy S25, 22 screens each, with no crash.

Needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Patch telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.0 or the Google Play build 13.2.1. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. Coming from an earlier HushTelegram, get 13.2 from the same place you got 13.1, patch it and install it over your current one with the same signing key. New installs uninstall the stock Telegram and keep the manager's signing key for updates.

### What's new

* **Telegram:** **Special contacts**, a new switch under **Show user and chat IDs** in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, off by default. With it on, a person's profile menu gets **Track this user**, and from then on HushTelegram keeps a history of what Telegram already shows you about them. That covers coming online and going offline, typing, and changes to their name, username, phone number or profile photo. It also notes when you save or remove them as a contact, and when they add you back or drop you. Telegram never says when someone blocks you, so that line is a guess, written when their photo and last seen disappear together. The **Tracked people** row under the switch lists everyone, newest activity first. Tap a person to read their history, clear it or stop tracking them. Each account can track up to 50 people, the newest 500 lines are kept for each, and nothing leaves the phone. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Ghost mode button**, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. It puts a ghost at the top of the chat list, next to Telegram's own buttons, and one tap turns Ghost mode on or off with a short message saying which. The ghost is filled while Ghost mode is on and just an outline while it's off. It steps aside while search is open.
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has a new switch, **Add Save to Gallery to stories**, off by default. A story's three-dot menu gets Telegram's own Save to Gallery without Premium, on stories that don't allow saving too. It saves only the ones you pick.
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has a new switch, **Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving**, off by default. Screenshots and screen recordings stop coming out black in those chats and channels, in their photos and videos, on their profiles and in protected stories. Telegram doesn't tell anyone you took one. Secret chats, view-once media and the passcode screen stay blocked. (#34)
* **Telegram:** **Save downloaded files** has a **What to copy** row right under its switch. Tick documents, music, photos, videos or voice messages, and only those kinds get a copy in Download/Telegram. Everything is ticked to start, so nothing changes until you untick something.
* **Telegram:** **Keep videos muted on volume keys** has a new switch, **Start videos without sound**, off by default. A video you open plays muted, so it won't blast out in public or cut over your music. Press a volume key and that video gets its sound. The next one you open starts quiet again. Round videos keep their sound. (#61)
* **Telegram:** **Disable double-tap reactions** has a new switch, **Hide the emoji pack line**, off by default. It takes the line that says a message contains emoji from some pack off the bottom of the long-press menu, along with the gap above it.
* **Telegram:** **Move All Chats**, under the folder tabs settings. It starts off. With it on, an account without Premium can drag All Chats to another place among its folder tabs, and it stays there after a restart. The place is kept on this phone for this account, so your other devices still show All Chats first.
* **Telegram:** **Fit all folder tabs** is a new switch under **Hide folder tab counters**, off by default. With lots of folders, the tabs above the chat list shrink until every one of them fits on the screen, so you don't have to scroll sideways to find one. They stop shrinking at a size that's still readable, and with only a few folders nothing changes. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Keep Telegram's files in internal storage** has a **Folder in internal storage** row under it, so Telegram's files can go in a folder you name, like Internal storage/Plus, instead of Internal storage/Telegram. Changing the name takes a restart, and files in the folder you used before stay there and still open. Leave it empty for Telegram. (#7)
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has a new switch, **Add Clear from cache to the message menu**, off by default. A video or file message gets a Clear from cache item. It stops a running download, deletes what Telegram kept of it and brings the download arrow back. A toast says how much was cleared, and copies you saved to Downloads or Pictures stay.
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has a new switch, **Add Save album art to the message menu**, off by default. A song with art, inside the file or on Telegram, gets a Save album art item that puts the picture in Pictures.
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has a new switch, **Add Save video cover to the message menu**, off by default. A video gets a Save video cover item that puts its biggest cover or thumbnail in Pictures, fetching it first if it isn't on the phone yet.
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has a new switch, **Add Forward to Saved Messages to the message menu**, off by default. A message you can forward gets a Forward to Saved Messages item in its long-press menu. Pick as is, without the sender's name, without the caption, or both, and it lands in your Saved Messages at once.
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has a new switch, **Add Fast forward to the message menu**, off by default. A message you can forward gets a Fast forward item in its long-press menu. Pick without the sender's name, without the caption, or both, then pick a chat, and it goes out at once.
* **Telegram:** **Strip link tracking** has a new switch, **Clean links when you copy or paste**, off by default. Copy a link in Telegram, or paste one into the message box, and tags like utm_source and fbclid come off. Only text that is one link and nothing else changes. Find it in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Faster downloads** has a third switch, **Faster uploads**, off by default. An upload keeps four times as many pieces on their way at once, up to 64. Telegram's servers still decide how fast an account can send, and the piece size and file size limits don't change. Find it in HushTelegram settings > Playback. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Hide popular apps** has a new switch, **Disable secret chats**, off by default. When someone asks for a secret chat, the phone ignores the request. Nothing is saved or shown and nothing is sent back, so the other person just sees it waiting. Secret chats you already have keep working. Find it in HushTelegram settings > Ads. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Sort chats by date** is a new switch under **Hide folder tab counters**, off by default, with a second one, **Oldest chats first**. Your unpinned chats line up by the date of their last message, newest or oldest first. Pinned chats and the archive row stay where they are, and nothing is sent to Telegram, so it only changes this phone's list. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Passcode for hidden chats** is a new switch under **Hide picked chats**, off by default. With it on, opening **Chats to hide**, turning off **Hide picked chats** and turning the switch itself off all ask for your Telegram passcode first. It guards this settings page only, so search still finds the hidden chats. Telegram needs a passcode set before it will turn on. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Administrators row in the side menu** is a new switch under **Hide folder tab counters**, off by default. It adds an **Administrators** row to the side menu. One tap lists only the groups and channels you own or manage, and the row then reads **Show all chats** to bring the rest back. It only changes this phone's list and starts off again when Telegram restarts. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Hide accounts** is a new switch under **Hide folder tab counters**, off by default. The accounts you tick in **Accounts to hide** leave Telegram's account lists, and only there. Each one stays signed in, keeps syncing, and its notifications follow Telegram's own settings. Nothing is signed out or deleted, the account you're using always shows, and at least one account always stays. An optional **Passcode for hidden accounts** switch asks for your Telegram passcode before the list opens. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Stop usage reports** now also holds **Receive only mode** and **Power off accounts**, both off by default. Pick accounts under each switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy. A receive only account reads, downloads and marks chats read, but messages, reactions, drafts and typing stay on the phone and show an error. A powered off account sends nothing, and its name in the side menu gets an (Off) tag. Telegram's connection can stay open in the background, so a powered off account may still receive messages and notifications. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Use normal paste** has a new switch, **Mention by ID**, off by default. Type @ and a user's ID number, or tg://user?id= and the ID, in the message box and it goes out as a real mention. It only works for people the app has already seen, in a chat or a group. For anyone else the text stays as you typed it and a short note says so. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.
* **Telegram:** **Faster downloads** has a third switch, **Download manager**, off by default. Files download one at a time, in the order you asked for them, instead of several at once. A **Downloads** row in the side menu (turn on **Side menu** too) lists what's downloading, what's waiting and what's finished, with a Cancel for each file still going. A file you open or play still jumps the line. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Voice messages in the music player** has a new switch, **Remember where playback stopped**, off by default. Videos, voice messages and music pick up where you left off, even short ones. Telegram only does that for long ones. Turn it off and everything plays as Telegram plays it. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Add Repeat to the message menu** has a new switch, **Select between**, off by default. It adds a button to the bar that shows while you pick messages. Tap it and everything between the first and last message you picked gets selected. Pick one past the end and the gap fills in. It stops at Telegram's 100 message limit. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **Folder icons** is a new row with the folder tab settings. Pick Regular, Bold or Filled and HushTelegram draws a small icon beside each folder in its own lists, like Folder to open. A folder called Work gets a briefcase, Friends a group, and a name it doesn't know gets a plain folder. Telegram's own folder tabs stay as they are. The icons are from Phosphor Icons (MIT). Off by default. (#53)
* **Telegram:** **HushTelegram icon and name** has a fourth **Icon style**, **Telegram's own icon**. Pick it with an **App name** and Telegram keeps its usual icon, with only the name under it changed. (#37)
* **Telegram:** **Test server sign-in**, under Chat list and off by default. When you sign in or add an account, the phone number screen shows Telegram's own Test Backend box. Tick it to sign that account in on Telegram's test servers, kept apart from your other accounts. Untick it to go back. With the box ticked, the phone screen also takes Telegram's test numbers (+999 66 X YYYY), which the regular app turns away as an unknown country code. (#59)
* **Telegram:** **Translate with an outside service** adds **Translate into** to a chat's three-dot menu, right under Translate this chat. It opens the same language list as the settings row, so you can switch between your language and English without leaving the chat. Pick one and the chat is written again in it. (#35)
* **Telegram:** **Bot token sign-in**, under Chat list and off by default. Turn it on and the phone number screen gets a **Sign in with a bot token** button, both on first sign-in and when you add an account. Paste the token @BotFather gave your bot and that account signs in as the bot. A wrong or revoked token gets a short message and the box stays open so you can fix it. Chats show up as people message the bot and you can answer them, but there's no older history, and a bot has no contacts, stickers or folders. A bot with a webhook set, or one another program is already reading, may not get its messages here. (#53)
* **Telegram:** Moved to Telegram 13.2. telegram.org's build is 13.2.0 (version code 72809) and the Google Play build is 13.2.1 (version code 72911). The 13.1 builds aren't supported anymore, so update Telegram before you patch.
* **Telegram:** **Hide the reaction picker** now covers the bubble of reactions that pops up over a selected message too, so tapping a post to pick it for a reply or a forward can't land on a reaction.
* **Telegram:** **Hide picked chats** now also takes hidden chats out of the forward picker, the share sheet and quick share. Saved Messages always stays in those lists.
* **Telegram:** **Import settings** no longer says nothing will change for a file that only picks other folder icons. It lists the change and offers to import it.
* **Telegram:** **Hide sponsored proxy channel** works the moment you flip it. The proxy's channel used to stay in the chat list until the next message or update came in.
* **Telegram:** **Hide Premium, gifts and Stars** now takes Send a Gift out of the three-dot menu on profiles and channels too. It was still sitting there with the switch on.
* **Telegram:** If you hide a pinned chat and unpin it on another device, the unpin now sticks. Hidden pins also count toward your pin limit here, so you see Telegram's limit message instead of a pin the server would turn down.
* **Telegram:** When Google sign-in fails on Telegram's login email screen, a short message now points at the email box. Telegram used to just stay on the screen after you picked an account, and a patched copy can't get past Google there.
* **Telegram:** If you use Telegram's Keep-Alive Service instead of push, messages no longer wait until you open the app. Android stopped that service about a minute after you left Telegram. Now it runs with a quiet notification and keeps going. A new switch under **Repair Firebase push registration**, **Keep the Keep-Alive Service running**, is on by default and only matters while Keep-Alive Service is on in Telegram's own settings. (#50, #54)
* **Telegram:** **Keep deleted messages** now saves a kept photo, and any kept file or video up to 20 MB, the moment the sender deletes it. Before, a photo you hadn't opened yet just spun forever, because Telegram can't fetch a deleted message's file later. (#2)
* **Telegram:** **Disable update checks** now hides the Update Telegram bar even when Telegram found the update before you turned the switch on. The bar used to stay, since Telegram only forgets an update when a later check comes back empty. (#60)
* **Telegram:** With **Keep Telegram's files in internal storage** on, the photos and videos Telegram downloads no longer fill up the phone's gallery. The folder now gets a .nomedia file, so the gallery only shows what you save to it yourself. (#60)
* **Telegram:** **Hide greeting stickers** now also hides the custom sticker a Premium or Business user picks for their intro, the one you see when you open an empty chat with them. Only the preview of your own intro, while you edit it, keeps its sticker. (#56)
* **Telegram:** In the **Side menu**, New Message has a pencil beside it again. Telegram 13 turned the old message icon into an eye, so the row looked like it would show you something.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Auto-forwarding rules
patches.description: Groundwork for forwarding new messages from one chat to another by rules you set. It doesn't forward anything yet, it only counts the new messages a rule would look at. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Black and white launch logo
patches.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Bot token sign-in
patches.description: Adds a Sign in with a bot token button to the phone number screen, so an account can sign in as a bot made with @BotFather. The bot sees a chat once someone messages it, without older history, contacts or stickers. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Lets you forward, copy and save from channels and chats that turn those off. A second switch, Open restricted channels, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Makes Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change sticker size
patches.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, where Receive only mode and Power off accounts also live, both off by default.

patches.name: Disable call debug upload
patches.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable draft link previews
patches.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable pull to archive
patches.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable update checks
patches.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches.name: Exact numbers
patches.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Faster downloads
patches.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. A third, Faster uploads, keeps four times as many upload pieces in flight. A fourth, Download manager, runs downloads one at a time in the order you asked and adds a Downloads row to the side menu. A fifth, Send photos and videos in the best quality, sends photos in HD and videos at their own size unless you lower one first. All five start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Folders by chat type
patches.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide Send as button
patches.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide Stories
patches.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide phone number
patches.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide popular apps
patches.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. More switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones. Disable secret chats ignores it when someone asks for a secret chat, with no answer sent back.

patches.name: Hide promotional banners
patches.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide recommendations
patches.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide time on stickers
patches.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide translate bar
patches.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Holiday look all year
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. Pick Telegram's own icon as the icon style to keep Telegram's icon and change only the name. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

options.description: The name under the icon, up to 30 characters. Leave it empty to keep Telegram.

HushTelegram colors is the blue badge. The plain styles draw just the H and plane, white on black or black on white, on Android 8 and up. Every style keeps the themed icon on Android 13. Telegram's own icon leaves Telegram's icon as it is, so only the app name changes.

patches.name: HushTelegram settings
patches.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. You can also press and hold Telegram's app icon or the Telegram title at the top of the chat list. Works as soon as you patch it in, with no switch.

patches.name: Ignore mentions in muted chats
patches.description: Stops mentions and replies in groups or channels you've muted from notifying you. Chats you haven't muted notify as before. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Keep deleted messages
patches.description: Keeps a message on your phone when someone else deletes it, and marks it deleted next to the time. Your own deletes still work normally. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Keep videos muted on volume keys
patches.description: Makes the volume keys only change the volume in a chat, instead of playing the video on screen with sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Message times with seconds
patches.description: Shows seconds in each message's time, like 9:41:27 PM, so messages sent close together are easy to tell apart. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Open links externally
patches.description: Opens ordinary web links in your browser instead of inside Telegram. Telegram links, sign-in and payment pages work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. A second switch there, Keep your location from Mini Apps, starts off. With it on, Mini Apps and web pages opened in Telegram are told your location isn't available.

patches.name: Play voice messages one at a time
patches.description: Stops the next voice or video message from playing by itself when one ends. A second switch, Keep voice messages quiet while locked, stops voice and round video messages from starting while your phone is locked. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Quiet contacts nag
patches.description: Once you've said no, stops the Contacts tab from asking for contacts access again and clears its warning badge. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Repair Firebase push registration
patches.description: Tries to help a patched Telegram sign up for push notifications, by giving Google's Firebase service Telegram's original certificate. If Telegram's server still turns the sign-up down, as it does with your own API ID, it turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection instead, unless you've set either one yourself. While Keep-Alive Service is on, it runs with a quiet notification so Android doesn't stop it in the background. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Reveal spoilers
patches.description: Shows spoiler text, photos and videos without the cover, so you don't have to tap. View-once media, sensitive content and login codes stay covered. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Save downloaded files
patches.description: Copies each file and song you download to Download/Telegram on your phone, where file managers and other apps can open it, the way Save to Downloads does one at a time. Files from secret chats and from chats that don't allow saving stay in Telegram. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Show user and chat IDs
patches.description: Adds a copyable ID number for a user or chat to the profile menu. A second switch also shows where the profile photo is stored. A third, Special contacts, adds Track this user to a person's profile menu and keeps a history of their status and profile changes on this phone. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Silence people outside your contacts
patches.description: Shows notifications from people who aren't in your contacts without sound or vibration. Bots, reminders and login codes keep their sound. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Start the camera on the rear lens
patches.description: Opens the attachment menu's camera on the rear lens every time, not the lens you used last. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Strip link tracking
patches.description: Removes tracking tags like utm_source, gclid and fbclid from links you open or share. Links with any other extra part stay unchanged. A second switch, Clean links when you copy or paste, does the same for a link you copy or paste into the message box. A third, No automatic sign-in on Telegram's sites, opens links to Telegram's own websites without the sign-in token Telegram adds for your account. All start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links.

patches.name: Suppress screenshot notification
patches.description: Stops Telegram from telling the other person you took a screenshot, in regular and secret chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Swipe back on profiles
patches.description: Makes a swipe right on a profile's photos or media tabs go back, like the rest of the profile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Test server sign-in
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Test Backend box on the sign-in screen for every new account. Tick it to sign that account in on Telegram's test servers, kept apart from your other accounts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Translate with an outside service
patches.description: Adds Translate here to a message's menu and Translate this chat to a chat's menu. Text you turn on goes to Google's web translate, or to an AI service with your own key if you set one, one message at a time, and nothing is sent before that. With an AI service, a How to translate box lets you say how you want it done. Telegram's own translation and its Premium checks stay as they are. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Turn off haptic feedback
patches.description: Stops Telegram from vibrating for taps, long presses, swipes and wrong entries. Calls and notifications still vibrate. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Turn off reaction effects
patches.description: Stops the emoji burst and fly-in when someone reacts. The reaction still shows on the message. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: UnifiedPush notifications
patches.description: Lets Telegram get its notifications through a UnifiedPush app like ntfy, for phones where Firebase notifications don't arrive. Telegram's servers wake it through the app, and the messages still come from Telegram. It also turns on Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service and Background Connection, unless you've set either one yourself, so messages keep coming while Telegram is closed. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Notifications.

patches.name: Unlock Premium features
patches.description: Makes Telegram on your phone treat your account as Premium, so the parts the app itself locks behind Premium open up. Telegram's servers still know your real plan, so their limits, like upload size, stay the same. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Use normal paste
patches.description: Pastes text exactly as you copied it, without Telegram adding formatting, tables or code styling. A second switch, Mention by ID, turns @ and a user ID typed in the message box into a real mention of people the app has already seen. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Use registered Maps API key
patches.description: Lets maps in your patched Telegram use a Google Maps key you registered. Leave the option empty to keep Telegram's key. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and enter your key.

options.description: A Google Maps key for Android apps, made in your own Google Cloud project. Limit it to Telegram's package name and your signing certificate (SHA-1).

patches.name: Use registered Telegram API credentials
patches.description: Signs in to Telegram with the API ID and hash you registered at my.telegram.org. Fill in both options, or leave both empty to keep the originals. It has no switch and isn't selected by default. Use Expert mode in Morphe Manager.

options.description: The number shown as App api_id at my.telegram.org/apps. Fill in the API hash too, or leave both empty.
The 32-character code shown as App api_hash at my.telegram.org/apps. Keep it private, and fill in the API ID too.

patches.name: Use system font
patches.description: Draws Telegram's bold, italic and code text in your phone's font instead of the one built into the app. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Voice messages in the music player
patches.description: Makes tapping the bar above a chat, while a voice message plays, open Telegram's full music player with a seek bar. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: AMOLED black
patches.description: Gives Telegram's Night and Dark themes pure black screens for a darker look. Message bubbles and menus keep their colors. On Android 13 and up the launch screen turns black too while your phone is in dark mode. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Add Repeat to the message menu
patches.description: Adds Repeat, Copy photo, Message details and Quick forward to a message's press-and-hold menu, for resending, copying and forwarding faster. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Allow chat blur on slower phones
patches.description: Lets slower phones show the blurred chat header and panels that Telegram keeps for fast phones. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Ask before sending a sticker
patches.description: Asks you to confirm before a sticker, GIF, voice or video message, or call goes out, so a stray tap doesn't send it. All four start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Auto-forwarding rules
patches.description: Groundwork for forwarding new messages from one chat to another by rules you set. It doesn't forward anything yet, it only counts the new messages a rule would look at. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Black and white launch logo
patches.description: With AMOLED black on and your phone in dark mode, the launch screen shows Telegram's logo in white on black instead of the blue one. It follows the switch on Android 13 and up. When Android reopens a Telegram it closed in the background, it shows the black screen in dark mode even with the switch off, since nothing can run that early. It isn't selected by default, since it has Morphe rebuild Telegram's resources. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it.

patches.name: Bot token sign-in
patches.description: Adds a Sign in with a bot token button to the phone number screen, so an account can sign in as a bot made with @BotFather. The bot sees a chat once someone messages it, without older history, contacts or stickers. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Bypass channel restrictions
patches.description: Lets you forward, copy and save from channels and chats that turn those off. A second switch, Open restricted channels, opens channels, groups and messages Telegram marks unavailable for copyright or local law, as long as Telegram still sends them. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Bypass integrity check
patches.description: Makes Telegram's two emulator checks always say your phone isn't an emulator. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Change sticker size
patches.description: Shows stickers in chats smaller or larger than Telegram does, at a size you pick. Animated emoji and dice keep their size. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Disable analytics
patches.description: Stops Telegram from reporting how you use the app, like how long you read channel posts and what you tap on Premium screens, and keeps the camera from reporting your phone's maker and model. Messages, calls and notifications work as before. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy, where Receive only mode and Power off accounts also live, both off by default.

patches.name: Disable call debug upload
patches.description: Stops your phone from sending call problem reports and log files to Telegram when its server asks for them. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable chat swipe actions
patches.description: Stops a sideways swipe on a chat from archiving, muting, pinning, deleting or marking it read, so a slip can't change a chat. Press and hold still has every action. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Disable double-tap reactions
patches.description: Stops a double tap on a message from adding a reaction, handy if you keep reacting by accident. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable draft link previews
patches.description: Keeps Telegram from looking up a link's preview before you send the message. Sent messages still get a preview. The same page has Keep drafts on this phone, so unsent drafts stop syncing to your other devices, and Keep searches on this phone, so what you type in the main search isn't sent to Telegram. Each starts off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Disable pull to archive
patches.description: Stops pulling down the chat list from opening the hidden archive. Open it from Archived chats in the chat list's menu instead. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list, then restart Telegram.

patches.name: Disable pull to next channel
patches.description: Stops pulling up at the bottom of a channel from jumping to the next channel. A second switch does the same for forum topics. The channel switch starts on and the topic switch starts off. Find them in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Disable update checks
patches.description: Stops Telegram from offering its own updates from telegram.org, which can't install over a patched app. Patch each new version in Morphe Manager instead. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Updates.

patches.name: Exact numbers
patches.description: Shows member, subscriber, view, reply and reaction counts in full, like 12,345 instead of 12.3K. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Faster downloads
patches.description: Downloads files in 512 KB pieces, 8 at a time, the way Telegram already does for accounts its servers pick, instead of 128 KB pieces 4 at a time. If a big piece fails, Telegram still drops back to small ones. A second switch, Hold automatic downloads on Data Saver, keeps Telegram from downloading media on its own while Android's Data Saver is on and the network is metered. A third, Faster uploads, keeps four times as many upload pieces in flight. A fourth, Download manager, runs downloads one at a time in the order you asked and adds a Downloads row to the side menu. A fifth, Send photos and videos in the best quality, sends photos in HD and videos at their own size unless you lower one first. All five start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Playback.

patches.name: Folders by chat type
patches.description: Makes Private, Groups, Channels and Bots folders in one tap. They're Telegram's own folders, so they show as tabs above the chat list and on your other devices too. Turning it off removes the ones it made, unless you renamed or changed them. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Gallery camera on tap
patches.description: Keeps the attachment gallery from starting the camera or asking for camera access when it opens. The camera starts when you tap its tile. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide Contacts tab
patches.description: Removes the Contacts tab from the bar at the bottom of the main screen, and swiping doesn't open its page either. The Calls or Settings tab stays as Telegram has it, and the chat list's new message button still opens your contacts. A second switch, Compact bottom bar, makes that bar shorter and only as wide as its tabs need. A third, Side menu, brings back a menu that slides in when you swipe right on the chat list. All three start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Premium, gifts and Stars
patches.description: Removes Premium, Stars, My Grams, Wallet, Business and Send a Gift from Settings, Wallet and Send Gram from the chat, profile and link menus, Gifts tabs on profiles, the Gift button in channels, and Premium stickers, their effects and Premium emoji packs for an account without Premium, for a less cluttered app. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide Send as button
patches.description: Hides your picture next to the message box in groups and channels where you could post as a channel, while you're posting as yourself. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide Stories
patches.description: Removes the story bar above your chats, the rings around profile pictures and the Post Story button. Profile stories and archives stay. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide Telegram Features and Invite Friends
patches.description: Removes the Telegram Features row from Settings and the Invite Friends rows from Contacts. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes sponsored messages in channels, sponsored accounts in search and ads in Telegram's video player, so you see fewer ads. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide blocked users in groups
patches.description: Leaves messages from people you've blocked out of groups and supergroups you open, and keeps them from notifying you. Nothing is deleted. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide channel bar buttons
patches.description: Removes the Search, Direct messages and Info buttons from the bar at the bottom of a channel. Mute and Join stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide contacts on Telegram
patches.description: Hides the Your contacts on Telegram list that shows under a short chat list. Chats, folders and search stay. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide folder tab counters
patches.description: Hides the unread count on each folder tab above the chat list, for a calmer look. A second switch, Open a folder at launch, opens the chat list on a folder you pick instead of All Chats. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Chat list.

patches.name: Hide gallery camera tile
patches.description: Removes the live camera tile from the attachment menu's photo grid, so the grid starts with your photos. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide greeting stickers
patches.description: Hides the sticker that an empty private chat offers to send as a greeting. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide keyboard on scroll
patches.description: Closes the on-screen keyboard when you start scrolling a chat, so you can read more. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide messages by keyword
patches.description: Leaves messages that match your own words or regular expressions out of the groups and channels you open, with one list for groups and one for channels. Private chats and your own messages stay. Nothing is deleted, and the filters stay on the phone. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide phone number
patches.description: Covers your own phone number with dots in Settings and your profile, which helps when you share your screen. A second switch, Don't share my number by default, leaves the share-my-number box clear when you add someone as a contact from their chat. Both start off. Turn them on in HushTelegram settings > Privacy.

patches.name: Hide popular apps
patches.description: Hides the Popular apps list on the Apps tab of search and stops Telegram from loading it. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads. More switches there start off. Search only my chats keeps search to your own chats and contacts, with nothing public. Find names in styled letters finds names written in decorative letters when you type plain ones. Disable secret chats ignores it when someone asks for a secret chat, with no answer sent back.

patches.name: Hide promotional banners
patches.description: Hides Premium, birthday and low Stars balance banners above your chat list. Account security notices still show. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide recommendations
patches.description: Hides suggested similar channels and bots, and stops Telegram from loading new suggestions. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide sender names when forwarding
patches.description: Turns on Telegram's Hide sender's name option each time you forward, so copies arrive without the original author. You can turn it off before sending. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Hide sponsored proxy channel
patches.description: Hides the sponsored channel a proxy adds to your chat list and folders. Your proxy settings aren't touched. On by default. Turn it off in HushTelegram settings > Ads.

patches.name: Hide time on stickers
patches.description: Removes the time and read checks from stickers and big animated emoji in chats. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel.

patches.name: Hide translate bar
patches.description: Hides the translate bar at the top of chats in another language. Translate moves to the chat's menu. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

patches.name: Holiday look all year
patches.description: Shows Telegram's Santa hat and New Year snow all year, not just around New Year. Starts off. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel. The same page has Emoji next to the chat list title, which puts an emoji or a few letters of your choice after Telegram's name, on this phone only.

patches.name: HushTelegram icon and name
patches.description: Gives your patched Telegram HushTelegram's own home screen icon, with a themed version on Android 13 and up, and can change the name under it. Pick Telegram's own icon as the icon style to keep Telegram's icon and change only the name. An alternate icon picked in Telegram's settings keeps its own look. It isn't selected by default. Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager to pick it and name the app. Only patching again without it puts Telegram's icon back.

options.description: The name under the icon, up to 30 characters. Leave it empty to keep Telegram.

HushTelegram colors is the blue badge. The plain styles draw just the H and plane, white on black or black on white, on Android 8 and up. Every style keeps the themed icon on Android 13. Telegram's own icon leaves Telegram's icon as it is, so only the app name changes.

patches.description: Adds a HushTelegram row to Telegram's Settings, where you turn features on or off, pause HushTelegram, save your choices and export a report. release_notes:
HushTelegram v0.0.24 has 69 patches for the Google Play build of Telegram 13.2.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72911) and telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72809). The 13.1 builds aren't supported anymore, so update Telegram before you patch. It's on Morphe patcher 2.3.0 now, which needs Morphe Manager 2.5.0 or newer. Most of it came from your reports again, and it changes something for #2, #7, #34, #35, #37, #50, #53, #54, #56, #59, #60 and #61. Special contacts keeps a history of the people you choose to track. The phone number screen can sign you in on Telegram's test servers or with a bot token, and another new switch lets screenshots work in chats that don't allow saving. New switches start off, except `Keep the Keep-Alive Service running`, which only does anything while Telegram's own Keep-Alive Service is on.

New in this release

- `Special contacts`, a new switch under `Show user and chat IDs` in HushTelegram settings > Look and feel, off by default. With it on, a person's profile menu gets `Track this user`, and from then on HushTelegram keeps a history of what Telegram already shows you about them. That covers coming online and going offline, typing, and changes to their name, username, phone number or profile photo. It also notes when you save or remove them as a contact, and when they add you back or drop you. Telegram never says when someone blocks you, so that line is a guess, written when their photo and last seen disappear together. The `Tracked people` row under the switch lists everyone, newest activity first. Tap a person to read their history, clear it or stop tracking them. Each account can track up to 50 people, the newest 500 lines are kept for each, and nothing leaves the phone. (#53)

- `Ghost mode button`, under Ghost mode in Privacy and off by default. It puts a ghost at the top of the chat list, next to Telegram's own buttons, and one tap turns Ghost mode on or off with a short message saying which. The ghost is filled while Ghost mode is on and just an outline while it's off. It steps aside while search is open.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Save to Gallery to stories`, off by default. A story's three-dot menu gets Telegram's own Save to Gallery without Premium, on stories that don't allow saving too. It saves only the ones you pick.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving`, off by default. Screenshots and screen recordings stop coming out black in those chats and channels, in their photos and videos, on their profiles and in protected stories. Telegram doesn't tell anyone you took one. Secret chats, view-once media and the passcode screen stay blocked. (#34)

- `Save downloaded files` has a `What to copy` row right under its switch. Tick documents, music, photos, videos or voice messages, and only those kinds get a copy in Download/Telegram. Everything is ticked to start, so nothing changes until you untick something.

- `Keep videos muted on volume keys` has a new switch, `Start videos without sound`, off by default. A video you open plays muted, so it won't blast out in public or cut over your music. Press a volume key and that video gets its sound. The next one you open starts quiet again. Round videos keep their sound. (#61)

- `Disable double-tap reactions` has a new switch, `Hide the emoji pack line`, off by default. It takes the line that says a message contains emoji from some pack off the bottom of the long-press menu, along with the gap above it.

- `Move All Chats`, under the folder tabs settings. It starts off. With it on, an account without Premium can drag All Chats to another place among its folder tabs, and it stays there after a restart. The place is kept on this phone for this account, so your other devices still show All Chats first.

- `Fit all folder tabs` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default. With lots of folders, the tabs above the chat list shrink until every one of them fits on the screen, so you don't have to scroll sideways to find one. They stop shrinking at a size that's still readable, and with only a few folders nothing changes. (#53)

- `Keep Telegram's files in internal storage` has a `Folder in internal storage` row under it, so Telegram's files can go in a folder you name, like Internal storage/Plus, instead of Internal storage/Telegram. Changing the name takes a restart, and files in the folder you used before stay there and still open. Leave it empty for Telegram. (#7)

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Clear from cache to the message menu`, off by default. A video or file message gets a Clear from cache item. It stops a running download, deletes what Telegram kept of it and brings the download arrow back. A toast says how much was cleared, and copies you saved to Downloads or Pictures stay.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Save album art to the message menu`, off by default. A song with art, inside the file or on Telegram, gets a Save album art item that puts the picture in Pictures.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Save video cover to the message menu`, off by default. A video gets a Save video cover item that puts its biggest cover or thumbnail in Pictures, fetching it first if it isn't on the phone yet.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Forward to Saved Messages to the message menu`, off by default. A message you can forward gets a Forward to Saved Messages item in its long-press menu. Pick as is, without the sender's name, without the caption, or both, and it lands in your Saved Messages at once.

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Add Fast forward to the message menu`, off by default. A message you can forward gets a Fast forward item in its long-press menu. Pick without the sender's name, without the caption, or both, then pick a chat, and it goes out at once.

- `Strip link tracking` has a new switch, `Clean links when you copy or paste`, off by default. Copy a link in Telegram, or paste one into the message box, and tags like utm_source and fbclid come off. Only text that is one link and nothing else changes. Find it in HushTelegram settings > More settings > Links. (#53)

- `Faster downloads` has a third switch, `Faster uploads`, off by default. An upload keeps four times as many pieces on their way at once, up to 64. Telegram's servers still decide how fast an account can send, and the piece size and file size limits don't change. Find it in HushTelegram settings > Playback. (#53)

- `Hide popular apps` has a new switch, `Disable secret chats`, off by default. When someone asks for a secret chat, the phone ignores the request. Nothing is saved or shown and nothing is sent back, so the other person just sees it waiting. Secret chats you already have keep working. Find it in HushTelegram settings > Ads. (#53)

- `Sort chats by date` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default, with a second one, `Oldest chats first`. Your unpinned chats line up by the date of their last message, newest or oldest first. Pinned chats and the archive row stay where they are, and nothing is sent to Telegram, so it only changes this phone's list. (#53)

- `Passcode for hidden chats` is a new switch under `Hide picked chats`, off by default. With it on, opening `Chats to hide`, turning off `Hide picked chats` and turning the switch itself off all ask for your Telegram passcode first. It guards this settings page only, so search still finds the hidden chats. Telegram needs a passcode set before it will turn on. (#53)

- `Administrators row in the side menu` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default. It adds an `Administrators` row to the side menu. One tap lists only the groups and channels you own or manage, and the row then reads `Show all chats` to bring the rest back. It only changes this phone's list and starts off again when Telegram restarts. (#53)

- `Hide accounts` is a new switch under `Hide folder tab counters`, off by default. The accounts you tick in `Accounts to hide` leave Telegram's account lists, and only there. Each one stays signed in, keeps syncing, and its notifications follow Telegram's own settings. Nothing is signed out or deleted, the account you're using always shows, and at least one account always stays. An optional `Passcode for hidden accounts` switch asks for your Telegram passcode before the list opens. (#53)

- `Stop usage reports` now also holds `Receive only mode` and `Power off accounts`, both off by default. Pick accounts under each switch in HushTelegram settings > Privacy. A receive only account reads, downloads and marks chats read, but messages, reactions, drafts and typing stay on the phone and show an error. A powered off account sends nothing, and its name in the side menu gets an (Off) tag. Telegram's connection can stay open in the background, so a powered off account may still receive messages and notifications. (#53)

- `Use normal paste` has a new switch, `Mention by ID`, off by default. Type @ and a user's ID number, or tg://user?id= and the ID, in the message box and it goes out as a real mention. It only works for people the app has already seen, in a chat or a group. For anyone else the text stays as you typed it and a short note says so. Turn it on in HushTelegram settings > Conversations.

- `Faster downloads` has a third switch, `Download manager`, off by default. Files download one at a time, in the order you asked for them, instead of several at once. A `Downloads` row in the side menu (turn on `Side menu` too) lists what's downloading, what's waiting and what's finished, with a Cancel for each file still going. A file you open or play still jumps the line. (#53)

- `Voice messages in the music player` has a new switch, `Remember where playback stopped`, off by default. Videos, voice messages and music pick up where you left off, even short ones. Telegram only does that for long ones. Turn it off and everything plays as Telegram plays it. (#53)

- `Add Repeat to the message menu` has a new switch, `Select between`, off by default. It adds a button to the bar that shows while you pick messages. Tap it and everything between the first and last message you picked gets selected. Pick one past the end and the gap fills in. It stops at Telegram's 100 message limit. (#53)

- `Folder icons` is a new row with the folder tab settings. Pick Regular, Bold or Filled and HushTelegram draws a small icon beside each folder in its own lists, like Folder to open. A folder called Work gets a briefcase, Friends a group, and a name it doesn't know gets a plain folder. Telegram's own folder tabs stay as they are. The icons are from Phosphor Icons (MIT). Off by default. (#53)

- `HushTelegram icon and name` has a fourth `Icon style`, `Telegram's own icon`. Pick it with an `App name` and Telegram keeps its usual icon, with only the name under it changed. (#37)

- `Test server sign-in`, under Chat list and off by default. When you sign in or add an account, the phone number screen shows Telegram's own Test Backend box. Tick it to sign that account in on Telegram's test servers, kept apart from your other accounts. Untick it to go back. With the box ticked, the phone screen also takes Telegram's test numbers (+999 66 X YYYY), which the regular app turns away as an unknown country code. (#59)

- `Translate with an outside service` adds `Translate into` to a chat's three-dot menu, right under Translate this chat. It opens the same language list as the settings row, so you can switch between your language and English without leaving the chat. Pick one and the chat is written again in it. (#35)

- `Bot token sign-in`, under Chat list and off by default. Turn it on and the phone number screen gets a `Sign in with a bot token` button, both on first sign-in and when you add an account. Paste the token @BotFather gave your bot and that account signs in as the bot. A wrong or revoked token gets a short message and the box stays open so you can fix it. Chats show up as people message the bot and you can answer them, but there's no older history, and a bot has no contacts, stickers or folders. A bot with a webhook set, or one another program is already reading, may not get its messages here. (#53)

Fixes

- `Import settings` no longer says nothing will change for a file that only picks other folder icons. It lists the change and offers to import it.

- `Hide sponsored proxy channel` works the moment you flip it. The proxy's channel used to stay in the chat list until the next message or update came in.

- `Hide Premium, gifts and Stars` now takes Send a Gift out of the three-dot menu on profiles and channels too. It was still sitting there with the switch on.

- If you hide a pinned chat and unpin it on another device, the unpin now sticks. Hidden pins also count toward your pin limit here, so you see Telegram's limit message instead of a pin the server would turn down.

- When Google sign-in fails on Telegram's login email screen, a short message now points at the email box. Telegram used to just stay on the screen after you picked an account, and a patched copy can't get past Google there.

- If you use Telegram's Keep-Alive Service instead of push, messages no longer wait until you open the app. Android stopped that service about a minute after you left Telegram. Now it runs with a quiet notification and keeps going. A new switch under `Repair Firebase push registration`, `Keep the Keep-Alive Service running`, is on by default and only matters while Keep-Alive Service is on in Telegram's own settings. (#50, #54)

- `Keep deleted messages` now saves a kept photo, and any kept file or video up to 20 MB, the moment the sender deletes it. Before, a photo you hadn't opened yet just spun forever, because Telegram can't fetch a deleted message's file later. (#2)

- `Disable update checks` now hides the Update Telegram bar even when Telegram found the update before you turned the switch on. The bar used to stay, since Telegram only forgets an update when a later check comes back empty. (#60)

- With `Keep Telegram's files in internal storage` on, the photos and videos Telegram downloads no longer fill up the phone's gallery. The folder now gets a .nomedia file, so the gallery only shows what you save to it yourself. (#60)

- `Hide greeting stickers` now also hides the custom sticker a Premium or Business user picks for their intro, the one you see when you open an empty chat with them. Only the preview of your own intro, while you edit it, keeps its sticker. (#56)

- In the `Side menu`, New Message has a pencil beside it again. Telegram 13 turned the old message icon into an eye, so the row looked like it would show you something.

Other changes

- Moved to Telegram 13.2. telegram.org's build is 13.2.0 (version code 72809) and the Google Play build is 13.2.1 (version code 72911). The 13.1 builds aren't supported anymore, so update Telegram before you patch.

- `Hide the reaction picker` now covers the bubble of reactions that pops up over a selected message too, so tapping a post to pick it for a reply or a forward can't land on a reaction.

- `Hide picked chats` now also takes hidden chats out of the forward picker, the share sheet and quick share. Saved Messages always stays in those lists.

The [changelog](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) has every earlier release too.

How to update

1. Install [Morphe Manager](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-manager) 2.5.0 or newer. 0.0.23 only needed 2.3.0, so update Manager first if that's what you patched with.
2. Add HushTelegram as a patch source: https://morphe.software/add-source?github=SysAdminDoc%2FHushTelegram
3. Get the right Telegram. From Google Play that's 13.2.1 (`org.telegram.messenger`, version code 72911), which [APKMirror](https://www.apkmirror.com/apk/telegram-fz-llc/telegram/) and Uptodown also carry. From telegram.org's [Download button](https://telegram.org/android) it's 13.2.0 (`org.telegram.messenger.web`, version code 72809). The patched app needs Android 9 or newer.
4. Coming from 0.0.23? Get 13.2 from the same place you got 13.1 (Google Play or telegram.org), patch it and install it over your current HushTelegram with the same Morphe Manager signing key. Your settings and chats stay. New to HushTelegram? Uninstall the stock Telegram first, since Android won't put a patched app over one signed with a different key. Your chats come back when you sign in, but secret chats don't. Back up Morphe Manager's signing key after your first patch. You'll need it for every update.
5. If Telegram turns down your login code with `API_ID_PUBLISHED_FLOOD`, that's Telegram refusing the public API ID that ships with any patched build, the Play one included. Register your own app at [my.telegram.org/apps](https://my.telegram.org/apps), using only letters and numbers in the short name. Then select `Use registered Telegram API credentials`, fill in `apiId` and `apiHash`, and patch again. The result installs over your current HushTelegram build. Keep both values private.
6. Want HushTelegram's own icon, or Telegram's logo in white on the black launch screen? Turn on Expert mode in Morphe Manager and pick `HushTelegram icon and name` or `Black and white launch logo` before you patch.
7. For notifications, open Telegram's Settings, tap Notifications, and turn on `Keep-Alive Service` and `Background Connection` under Other, near the bottom of the page. On phones where Firebase notifications don't come through, try the `UnifiedPush notifications` switch on HushTelegram's Notifications page with a UnifiedPush app like ntfy. It turns those two on for you unless you've set them yourself.
8. To change HushTelegram's switches, open Telegram's Settings and tap HushTelegram settings, or press and hold the Telegram title at the top of your chat list. The Ways in section on that page decides which of those (plus the side menu row and the icon shortcut) stay.

The `.mpp` download is a patch bundle, not a Telegram APK. [Installation instructions](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushTelegram#install).

What was checked

All 2048 runtime tests passed locally, and all 625 patch tests passed too (162 unit tests and 463 that patch the real Telegram APKs), along with both Android lints (the shared library and the Telegram extension). Every one of the 69 patches applied without forcing to telegram.org's Telegram 13.2.0 (version code 72809) and to the Google Play build of 13.2.1 (version code 72911). For each patched build the release receipt checked the package name, version, manifest, resource table, native libraries and zip alignment.

Both builds were patched from this exact bundle and installed over the HushTelegram already on a Galaxy S25, without clearing its data. Both were signed in to Telegram. On each one the walk opened Telegram's Settings, Privacy, Folders and Themes pages and a channel, then every section of the HushTelegram settings and the Changed switches page. That's 22 screens per build, with no crash and no problem found on either.

The new `Allow screenshots in chats that don't allow saving` switch was checked on the same phone. With it off, a bot message that blocks saving and a channel with Restrict saving content both came out black in screenshots, same as stock Telegram. With it on, both showed normally.
